description: Creates Polarion user accounts from the supplied user resource data. Requires user administration permission and valid unique user IDs. Use `getUser` to inspect an account or `patchUser` to update one. Effect: creates a new resource. Repeating this call may create additional resources; it is not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

name: postUsers
